senses.gloss: m. (סָכָה) what is looked for, prospect, hope.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 21b:2">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בטל סִיכּוּיָם</he> their prospect is frustrated. Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII <he>סִיכּוּיִי</he>, v. <cite ref="O00089"><he>סֵבֶר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אני סִכּוּיְיךָ</he> I (the Lord) am thy hope.
